name: Sasotte Otoshite Saiinjutsu
original_name: 誘ってオトして催淫術
source:
Yuji, whose father is a hypnotist, lives an ordinary life. One day, he and Yuri, his childhood friend, are late for school, and stopped at the school gate by a teacher. They are somehow excused, and he just tries to hypnotize the teacher, pretending his father, and he succeeds it. He thinks, "It would be great if I can control someone using hypnosis." After school, he tries to hypnotize Yuri to do indecent things....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302110225/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005778]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
雄二的父亲是一名催眠师，他过着平凡的生活。一天，他和青梅竹马百合上学迟到了，在校门口被老师拦住。他们不知怎的被放了进去，于是他冒充父亲试着催眠那位老师，竟然成功了。他心想：“如果能用催眠控制别人就好了。”放学后，他试图催眠百合去做下流的事……
